Chapter 1181 - 5: The Ten Thousand Domains Come To Pay Homage (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 1181: Chapter 5: The Ten Thousand Domains Come to Pay Homage (Subscription Requested)

"This is my Chaos Continent."

Lin Yuan looked down, the location he chose to open the Chaos Continent wasn’t within any Void Domain.

Instead, it was in the Desolate Void between one Void Domain and another, where the Chaos Void mainly consisted of Desolate Void in ninety-nine percent of the area.

In a sense, the Desolate Void is the main body of the Chaos Void. As for the Void Domains?

They’re akin to small islands in a vast ocean.

The reason why most cultivators reside in a particular Void Domain is because the Chaos Qi within the Void Domain is thick, making the living environment better.

"The space-time rules have stabilized, the other myriad rules will naturally operate and evolve."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly. Given his strength, it took him several years to open it up, which shows he invested great effort in this Chaos Continent.

Although the Chaos Continent is opened in the Desolate Void, the space-time rules Lin Yuan has drawn in directly siphon large areas of nearby Chaos Qi.

The notion that Chaos Qi is scarce in the Desolate Void is based on the premise that the vastness of the Desolate Void’s area results in a low Chaos Qi total; averaging out leads to the belief that Chaos Qi is thin.

However, if the Chaos Qi from the surrounding large area is gathered in one small location, the Chaos Qi there certainly isn’t thin.

Of course, to achieve this, most Chaos Great Saints can’t manage, the area involved is too expansive.

Only Lin Yuan, with his space-time rules reaching the Ninth Realm and his deep understanding of space-time, dares to attempt this.

Normally, when Chaos Great Saints want to open up a Chaos Continent, they would largely prefer to open it in existing Void Domains, then occupy everything within that Void Domain.

...

In the distance, a large group of Chaos Venerables had already gathered to watch.

In several years, the matter of the Galaxy Great Saint opening the Chaos Continent spread rapidly.

Chaos Venerables from thousands upon ten thousand Void Domains in the vicinity were flocking here; even though most hadn’t arrived yet, there were still quite a few gathered.

The number of Chaos Venerables here far exceeded those present when the Xuanhuang Universe emerged.

When the Xuanhuang Universe emerged, many Chaos Venerables knew their limitations and didn’t join the excitement.

But as for the Galaxy Great Saint opening the Chaos Continent? Almost all Venerables rushed over; if not in person, then their avatars, all to witness the Galaxy Great Saint’s exhibited mastery of space-time during the opening.

"My heavens, the Chaos Continent opened by the Galaxy Great Saint is probably as vast as a tenth of a Void Domain."

"Drawing in the scarce Chaos Qi from the surrounding Desolate Void, making the Chaos Qi on the Chaos Continent exceedingly abundant, such methods, such space-time mastery, truly warranted the title of Galaxy Great Saint."

"The Galaxy Great Saint is indeed merciful, not opening the Chaos Continent within a Void Domain, which would squeeze the survival space of weaker races."

...

The Chaos Venerables exclaimed in amazement, watching over the years as an unprecedentedly vast boundless land was opened from nothing, gaining in the process.

The stronger one was, the more they revered the methods displayed by the Galaxy Great Saint; the newly ascended Chaos Venerables might only see a boundless land being opened.

Slightly seasoned Chaos Venerables could see the weaving of space-time rules on this boundless land, with myriad paths operating.

Some peak Venerables could further see the Chaos Continent’s radiating influence on the endless Desolate Void around, like the rays of the Fierce Sun spreading brilliance.

"You all may come in to take a look."

Lin Yuan looked at the gathered Chaos Venerables around and spoke with a smile.

The Chaos Continent was not only a lair but also could be developed into a trade hub for nearby Void Domains.

Over time, this could lead to the accumulation of vast wealth, consistent with Lin Yuan’s constant inclinations.

Resources obtainable through normal trading were preferred over the risky exploration of secret realms.

And allowing these Chaos Venerables to enter and observe had a significant impact on establishing this Chaos Continent.

"Alright."

"Thank you, Galaxy Great Saint."

"Then we shall enter."

The gathered Chaos Venerables felt a stirring within and immediately began to enter the Chaos Continent in an orderly fashion.

Though the space-time within the Chaos Continent was entirely controlled by Lin Yuan, the Chaos Venerables felt no worry, nor did they suspect the Galaxy Great Saint to harbor lethal intentions.

With the prowess Galaxy Great Saint exhibited, if he harbored ill-intent, why invite them in? He could act outside directly.

"Congratulations to the Galaxy Great Saint for opening the Chaos Continent."

"This Chaos Continent is so vast, I wonder if it could accommodate... "

The Chaos Venerables handed their greetings to Lin Yuan upon entering and inquired about the allowance of trade organizations to settle in.

With the renown of the Galaxy Great Saint, and the scale of the Chaos Continent, over time it would surely attract many strong figures, making trade settlements inevitable.

....

"Didn’t expect the greetings to accumulate billions of Chaos Stones."

Lin Yuan sat in the center of the Chaos Continent, pondering silently.

Billions of Chaos Stones, even for a Chaos Great Saint, is a considerable fortune.

"Now that the Chaos Continent is opened, migrate human civilization in."

Lin Yuan looked at the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, while the Star Tear Fragment World’s environment was decent, it couldn’t compare with the current Chaos Continent he constructed.

Buzz.

Lin Yuan’s thought stirred slightly.

The entire Star Tear Fragment World was moved from the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent to his forefront.

Subsequently, under the management of nine ultimate warriors and three goddesses, human civilization began a grand migration anew.
